reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses Cr–Zr interdiffusion in Cr-coated Zr-alloy cladding with a specific, testable intervention (5 at.% Al doping) and a physically sound mechanism (in situ composite oxide barrier), supported by relevant evidence on Al-containing coatings.
